title: Three boxes

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Before we start saving, you need to know how git organizes things.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: It uses three areas, like boxes. The first is your **working folder**, where you edit files normally.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: The third is the **repository**, where your permanent commits live.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: In between is the **staging area**. It's like a loading dock where you prepare your next commit.

questions.prompt: Which area holds the commit you are currently preparing?
questions.explanation: The staging area is where you pick and choose files for the next commit.

recap: Git has three areas: the working folder (your desk), the staging area (the loading dock), and the repository (the vault).
